language isolate | iso3 = dsz | isoexception = | glotto = mard1245 | glottorefname = Mardin Sign Language | map = Lang Status 40-SE.svg }} '''Mardin Sign Language''' ('''MarSL'''; {{Langx|tr|Mardin İşaret Dili}}) is a [[family sign language]] of Turkey.{{Cite web |title=Mardin Sign Language |url=https://www.ethnologue.com/language/dsz/ |url-status=live}} It was originally spoken in the town of [[Mardin]], dating back at least five generations in a single extended family. All speakers now live in [[İzmir]] or [[Istanbul]], and the younger generation has shifted to [[Turkish Sign Language]].{{Cite web |title=Signing in a ‘deaf family’ – documentation of the Mardin Sign Language, Turkey {{!}} Endangered Languages Archive |url=https://www.elararchive.org/dk0134 |access-date=2026-01-26 |website=www.elararchive.org}} Signers refer to their language as "dilsizce" (Turkish for "deaf language") or "eski işaretler" (Turkish for "old signs"). == Documentation == MarSL is [[Endangered language|severely endangered]]. Most young signers use Turkish Sign Language, and the only fluent users of MarSL are over 50. Recent efforts have been made to create corpora for MarSL, as well as document the language.{{Citation |last=Zeshan |first=Ulrike |title=Documentation of endangered sign languages: The case of Mardin Sign Language |date=2013 |work=Keeping Languages Alive: Documentation, Pedagogy and Revitalization |pages=29–41 |editor-last=Jones |editor-first=Mari C. |url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/keeping-languages-alive/documentation-of-endangered-sign-languages-the-case-of-mardin-sign-language/3D85354D9B09058D250FB24657D4C43F |access-date=2026-01-26 |place=Cambridge |publisher=Cambridge University Press |isbn=978-1-107-02906-4 |last2=Dikyuva |first2=Hasan |editor2-last=Ogilvie |editor2-first=Sarah}} ==See also== * [[Deafness in Türkiye]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://web.archive.org/web/20120910123931/http://www.uclan.ac.uk/schools/journalism_media_communication/islands/villagesign/mardin_sl.php Mardin Sign Language] – University of Central Lancashire *[https://www.elararchive.org/dk0134 Corpus of Mardin Sign Language] {{Languages of Turkey}} {{Authority control}} [[Category:Village sign languages]] [[Category:Sign languages of Turkey]] [[Category:Language isolates of Asia]] [[Category:Culture in Mardin]] {{Turkey-stub}} {{sign-lang-stub}}
